title: Using our trademark
slide_intent: Teach writers and designers to distinguish approved logo artwork from a written occurrence of a name. Each requires a different handling decision.
strategic_value: Voltera can keep the appearance of its marks consistent across assets while documenting how the guide treats the first written use of a name.
demonstration: The page names Voltera and Alta, lists restrictions on modifying artwork and compares the guide’s first and subsequent written forms of Alta.
practical_value: Use an approved logo asset for an identity mark and consult the separate first-use example for prose.
